name: Bramble-Thrall Owlbear

Actions.name: Beak
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Living Bramble Lash (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 15 feet. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: The owlbear lashes out with a length of living bramble, forcing a creature it can see to make a Dexterity saving throw.
Actions.expresses: thorns that lash and tangle prey
Actions.expressedQuote: the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn

lore: An owlbear cub that bedded down in a barrow-thicket of vampiric bramble woke grown through with thorns, and now it patrols that thicket's edges, dragging kills back to feed the roots that command it.

generation.userConcept: a thing like an owlbear but grown through with brambles
generation.cite: composition after Ogre (CR 2) — one colossal hit, no traits

monsterDescription: a thing like an owlbear but grown through with brambles
